# ARD Mediathek

> > ARD Mediathek is Germany's public broadcasting media library offering livestreams, news coverage, and on-demand video content from ARD channels including tagesschau24 and Das Erste.

The platform provides comprehensive access to German public television content, featuring news programming, current affairs coverage, and archived videos. Users can watch live broadcasts and catch up on programs from ARD's network of channels.

## Key Topics

- tagesschau24
- Das Erste
- livestream
- nachrichten (news)
- video-archiv (video archive)
- news-channel
- german-news
- current-affairs
- media-library
- Selenskyj
- Merz
- Nahen Osten (Middle East)
- international coverage

## News Channels & Livestreams

- [tagesschau24 Videos](https://www.ardmediathek.de/tagesschau24?sendung=28721986857173): 24-hour news channel livestream and complete video archive featuring current affairs, breaking news, and in-depth coverage from tagesschau24
